title: Practice
tagline: Abhyasa — steady effort, day after day

sutra.meaning: Repeated practice without atachment is the way to still the mind

sections.insight: Consistency and letting go brings mastery. I will not be focused on the end result while I practice regularly.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Can I practice consistently without constantly measuring my progress?
sections.practice: Do a single task during the day with full attention

sutra.meaning: Practice and detachment can make one experience samadhi in four ways- i) self-analysis, wherein one logically understands the 'Self' and experiences a shift within. ii) synthesis of senses and thought which brings about 'an awareness' without any disturbance iii) bliss iv) only the experience of 'I am'

sections.insight: It can be a gradual movement from one to the other or any one of the way

sutra.sanskrit:
मैत्रीकरुणामुदितोपेक्षाणां सुखदुःखपुण्यापुण्यविषयाणां भावनातश्चित्तप्रसादनम् 
प्रच्छर्दनविधारणाभ्यां वा प्राणस्य
sutra.meaning:
The mind becomes clarified and serene by cultivating: 
Maitri (Friendliness) toward those who are happy,
Karuṇa (Compassion) toward those who are unhappy or suffering ,
Mudita (Joy) toward those who are virtuous or meritorious and
Upekṣa (Equanimity/Indifference) toward those who are non-virtuous or sinful (apuṇya). 


Or regulating the breath calms the mind too.

sections.insight:
One should be friendly and compassionate to all but be in close proximity to only those who are in a happy state of mind for sad and grumpy people will make you sad and grumpy which will do no favours to you or the person concerned.








Breath is the key to balance.
sections.reflectionPrompt: I need to watch my emotional entanglement while dealing with other people. Can I take a step back and observe myself?
sections.practice: Observe your breathing. Inhale full and watch your belly inflate; exhale slowly and see it deflate. Continue for a few mins.

sutra.meaning: Mastery of contemplation gives the power to extend from  the smallest to largest and from the subtlest to the grossest.

sections.reflectionPrompt: How can I expand my awareness?
sections.practice: Observe things and events deeply, down to their very core.
